newsSince: Horizon Robotics rolled out HSD V2.0 with end-to-end/world-model upgrades and continues to publish embodied-AI research such as HoloAgent/HoloMotion. The counterweight is structural customer risk as major Chinese OEM customers develop in-house chips, even while BYD continues testing Horizon systems.

sources.label: Horizon HSD V2.0 upgrade / structural risk
Meyka - Horizon Robotics slides on profitability pressure

verdicts.rankRationale: The edge-AI and embodied-AI evidence improved, but the name remains mostly an autonomous-driving chip/software proxy and customer in-sourcing risk tempers the robotics upgrade.
verdicts.bull: Leading China edge-AI ADAS platform; deep pullback (-56% YTD) and physical-AI optionality if losses inflect.
verdicts.neutral: Not a pure humanoid name; valuation cheaper but no proof of profit inflection yet.
verdicts.bear: Widening losses, cash burn, and insider selling undercut the commercialization thesis; -18.5% since Jun 9.
verdicts.primaryRisk: Persistent losses, cash burn, insider selling, China-tech sentiment
